cruise_speed_mps.description: Normal forward speed, metres/second. Simulated motors only.

stop_gap_m.description: Minimum front clearance in metres BEFORE adding speed-dependent braking and reaction allowances.

resume_gap_m.description: Restart only above this front clearance, after clear_hold_s. Must exceed stop_gap_m.

slow_gap_m.description: Begin reducing forward speed below this front clearance in metres. Must be at least resume_gap_m.

clear_hold_s.description: Seconds of clear path required before restarting.

braking_deceleration_mps2.description: Assumed available braking deceleration in the stopping-distance calculation. Physical value must be measured.

reaction_time_s.description: Additional reaction allowance in seconds multiplied by measured robot speed.

corridor_half_width_m.description: Half-width of the forward travel corridor in metres; includes desired side margin.

front_offset_m.description: Distance from camera origin to robot front in metres. Update with geometry.

wheel_radius_m.description: Wheel radius in metres used to convert encoder angle to travel.

duration_s.description: Scripted simulation duration in seconds. Validation timeline currently expects 65.

minimum_slow_speed_fraction.description: Slow-zone minimum speed as a fraction of cruise speed; does not override a STOP.

unknown_range_center_fraction.description: Width fraction of central image band that triggers a conservative stop for objects with unknown range.
